$schema_note: Technical Debt Registry seed - BAILEYS-HOTFIX-AND-DEBT-REGISTRY-V01. All entries RELATED/NON-BLOCKING discovered during BAILEYS-DISPATCH-E2E-V01 physical verification (2026-08-24). Evidence First: every entry carries file:line or observable incident evidence from HEAD 6c94b42.

debts.statement: services/whatsapp-bridge has its own TypeScript project (npm run typecheck) that is not part of any global quality gate, so a fully broken bridge (unresolvable imports) can pass lint/build/unit/e2e and reach main.

evidence.reason: At HEAD 6c94b42 imported non-existent loadJWTConfig/JWTConfig from ./jwt.js; global gates were green while bridge boot crashed with ESM SyntaxError
'typecheck' script exists (tsc --noEmit) but is referenced by no gate

debts.remediation_sketch: Add bridge typecheck (and optionally bridge vitest) as explicit gate for any task touching services/whatsapp-bridge/**

debts.statement: sendReply() discards the value returned by socket.sendMessage, losing the WhatsApp message ID needed for end-to-end correlation and delivery diagnosis.

evidence.reason: await socket.sendMessage(...) result not captured; SendReplyResult {sent,asImage} carries no message id
Physical test: send to wrong-format JID reported success=true while nothing was delivered; impossible to correlate because no WA message id was logged

debts.remediation_sketch: Capture sendMessage return, log {messageId} and expose in /send HTTP result

debts.statement: SessionManager.reconnect() clears session listeners without migrating them to the recreated socket, orphaning WebSocket subscribers across reconnection.

evidence.reason: session.listeners.clear() during teardown; pendingListeners only receives subscribers that arrive WHILE connect() is in flight
WS client subscribed before /reconnect received zero events afterwards; resubscribing AFTER reconnect immediately caught the qr event

debts.remediation_sketch: Move cleared listeners into pendingListeners inside reconnect() so doConnect re-attaches them

debts.statement: SupabaseAuthStore.updateStatus uses UPDATE without upsert, so status fields (including last_qr) are silently dropped for businesses that have no whatsapp_sessions row yet.

evidence.reason: Fresh E2E session stayed 'connecting' with qr generated over WS while whatsapp_sessions row never appeared; DB polling found nothing

debts.remediation_sketch: Upsert by business_id or ensure row creation at connect() time

debts.statement: Mexican mobile numbers must be normalized to 521XXXXXXXXXX JIDs; sending to 52XXXXXXXXXX reports success but silently never delivers.

evidence.reason: to taken raw from metadata without MX normalization
Image dispatch to 524761501122@s.whatsapp.net: success=true, NOTHING arrived (human confirmed); identical dispatch to 5214761501122@s.whatsapp.net: image physically received (human confirmed)

debts.remediation_sketch: Dedicated mission BAILEYS-MX-JID-NORMALIZATION-V01 (normalize at adapter boundary + customer phone storage)

debts.statement: The Vitanova WhatsApp session (4fb7418d-6c98-4a09-9094-4e4e4b2006a6) is stuck in a 'conflict: replaced' reconnect loop because another linked device took over the account session.

evidence.reason: Repeated {tag:'conflict',attrs:{type:'replaced'}} stream errors + '[session-manager] reconnecting 4fb7418d...' loop observed throughout the session
Only one bridge process existed locally (verified via Get-CimInstance); competitor is an external linked device

debts.remediation_sketch: Human action: review 'Dispositivos vinculados' on the Vitanova line and unlink unknown devices; then verify loop stops
